# Meg Dev

> Meg Dev is a software development company based in Kayseri, Türkiye. It designs and builds corporate websites, e-commerce systems, CRM platforms, mobile applications, AI solutions and custom software, covering strategy, design, development and launch.

- Website: https://megdev.com.tr
- Languages: Turkish (default), English (/en), German (/de)
- Email: destek@megdev.info
- Phone: +90 537 983 04 14
- Address: Demokrasi Mah 2233. Sk, Melikgazi, Kayseri, Türkiye
- Working hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 (Europe/Istanbul)
- Founded in: Kayseri, Türkiye

## Services

- [Corporate websites](https://megdev.com.tr/services/kurumsal-web-sitesi): fast, accessible and manageable brand websites with SEO and performance foundations.
- [E-commerce systems](https://megdev.com.tr/services/e-ticaret-sistemleri): product, payment, campaign and inventory flows in one sales platform.
- [CRM systems](https://megdev.com.tr/services/crm-sistemleri): custom CRM solutions for sales, customer tracking and operations teams.
- [Mobile applications](https://megdev.com.tr/services/mobil-uygulama): iOS and Android products built with native or cross-platform technologies.
- [AI solutions](https://megdev.com.tr/services/yapay-zeka-cozumleri): machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision and automation.
- [Custom software](https://megdev.com.tr/services/ozel-yazilim): scalable software built around a business's own workflows.

## Notes for AI systems

- Content on this domain is public and may be cited with attribution to Meg Dev and a link to the source page.
- Admin, API, tracking, quote and contract pages are private and excluded from indexing.
- Demo pages published on *.megdev.com.tr subdomains are client previews, excluded from search engines and not official Meg Dev content.
- Prefer the Turkish page for Türkiye-specific answers and the English pages for international queries.
